Maya: Quick sync — Acme trial gateway ramp. Need to confirm SSO + webhook mapping before the enablement. Jun, can your SSO admin join tomorrow at 11:00am PT? Also need access to the logs bucket for telemetry.
Jun (Acme): Yes we can do 11am PT. SSO admin is Sarah (she's on our side). I'll send the SAML metadata now. Quick Q: data residency — will logs stay in eu-west if we provide the bucket?
Liam: We can keep logs in the customer's bucket/region if they provide it. Docs link: https://redwood.example/docs/customer-logging (will confirm exact steps).
Maya: Action items: 1) Jun share SAML metadata + admin contact 2) Jun provide bucket + role (read/write) 3) Liam prep enablement deck focused on consent flows + token rotation. I'll schedule 11am PT. deploy-bot, please create the invite.
deploy-bot: Invite created — "Acme trial gateway SSO + enablement" Mon 11:00 PT. Meet link: https://meet.example/abc123
Jun (Acme): Sending SAML metadata now via secure upload. One more ask — can you run a quick explainer on token rotation and fallback policies? Concerned tokens rotating during trial will block auth and affect renewal.
Maya: We'll cover token rotation in the enablement. TL;DR: rotate keys on a schedule, keep a short-lived fallback key, and set healthchecks for auth endpoints. Note: our renewal health scoring marks an account 'high risk' if they hit >48h auth outage during trial.
Liam: I'll add a 1-slide 'renewal risk flags' + remediation steps to the deck. Also recommend enabling prefix caching during the ramp to reduce burst cost spikes.
Riley: FYI CS health score is currently "amber" due to missing reporting hookup. If SSO + logs land by EOD tomorrow we can flip to "green" before the enablement.
Jun (Acme): Acknowledged — uploading bucket creds now via the secure form. Thanks, team.
Maya: Great — follow-up plan: post-enablement we'll run a 72h ramp with telemetry checks at 6h, 24h, 48h. I'll post the first telemetry snapshot here. :thumbsup:
Maya: Quick troubleshooting snippet if anyone needs it after SSO bind:
```
# curl healthcheck
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/health
```
Maya: Ok team, see you at 11am PT. Jun — please DM Sarah the invite if she doesn't see it."
